deadline_text_verbatim: "Applications for all 2027 entry undergraduate courses, except those with a 15 October deadline, should arrive at UCAS by 18:00 (UK time) on 13 January 2027. This is our 'equal consideration' deadline, which means course providers must consider all applications received by this time equally."
source_authority_note: ucas.com is the UK's national centralised undergraduate admissions service, not warwick.ac.uk itself -- this specific equal-consideration date is a national UCAS date that applies identically to every UCAS-member institution (including Warwick and Durham), so it is recorded once here as the authoritative source for the 2027 date pending Warwick's own site republishing it.
researcher_notes: Same national date also applies to Durham (see DUR0001) -- recorded once per institution per this corpus's existing convention (each university lane cites the UCAS date independently), not deduplicated across universities.
